name: Oni no Kamen
source:
While walking down the street one night I suddenly smelt the scent of tobacco, and the sound of shoes hitting the concrete.

Sensing a presence, I turned around.
It turned out to be someone else - but even now, I still can't get rid of the fear that it may be "him".

[Translated from the official site]
translation:
某晚走在街上，我突然聞到一股菸味，還聽見鞋底敲在水泥地上的聲音。

察覺到身後有人，我轉過身。
那是另一個人——可直到現在，我仍無法擺脫「可能是他」的恐懼。

［譯自官方網站］
